sentences.en: She asked him to leave and take all his belongings.
sentences.zh: 1. 她要求他离开，并带走所有他的东西。

sentences.en: Please keep your belongings and clothing clear of the doors.
sentences.zh: 2. 请将您的物品和衣物远离门放置。

sentences.en: May your belongings be new, may your friends be old.
sentences.zh: 3. 愿你的新物陪伴，旧友长伴。

senses.zh: 动产;财物 家眷；亲属；亲戚
